scope: Li Sao, opening self-presentation, political disillusionment, celestial journeys, divination, ascent and closing coda in Chu Ci received tradition.
editorial_boundary: The narrator’s self-description is read as poetic voice, not established autobiography; Wang Yi’s Qu Yuan reading is later interpretation.
